questions.text: How would you validate user input before saving it through an API? Explain one example.
An API sometimes creates duplicate records after a retry. How would you investigate and prevent this?
Design a reliable background processing service. How would you handle duplicate delivery, failures and observability?
A small mobile robot uses an ultrasonic sensor and DC motors. How can it detect an obstacle and respond safely?
A robot repeatedly oscillates around its target position. How would you investigate sensing, timing and controller behavior?
How would you design fault handling for a fleet of robots that must remain safe when sensing or network communication fails?
Explain how a microcontroller reads an analog sensor and uses the result to control a digital output.
When would you use an interrupt instead of polling? Explain how you would keep an interrupt routine reliable.
An embedded device intermittently misses its timing deadline. How would you diagnose and redesign the critical path?
Before building a dashboard from a new dataset, what checks would you perform and why?
A dashboard total changes unexpectedly when a filter is applied. How would you inspect the data model and calculation?
How would you design an analytics pipeline whose reports remain trustworthy as schemas and source data change?
How do you distinguish stress from strain, and why does the distinction matter when choosing a material?
Two manufactured parts do not fit despite matching their nominal CAD dimensions. How would you investigate the assembly?
How would you validate a mechanical component subject to repeated loading before accepting its design?
Describe a problem you worked on. What was your role, and what did you learn?
Describe a decision where two reasonable approaches had different trade-offs. How did you choose and evaluate the result?
How would you lead a complex project when requirements are uncertain and different teams disagree on priorities?
